title: v0.1.35 Text Selection Mode & Status Bar Rendering Fixes
story: Users reported text selection being impossible due to mouse trapping, along with visual glitches including duplicated status bars and ANSI escape codes bleeding into standard views.

before_after.before: Mouse drag selection failed or was trapped by TUI cell motion.
before_after.after: Pressing ctrl+y toggles native terminal text selection mode.

before_after.before: Duplicate status bars appeared at screen bottom with line overflow.
before_after.after: Status bar renders cleanly in a single clamped row.

decisions.why: Allows toggling mouse cell motion dynamically to enable native terminal mouse selection without breaking scroll wheel functionality.
decisions.who_benefits: Users selecting text from chat buffers.
decisions.tradeoff: Mouse wheel scroll is disabled while in native selection mode.

deliberately_not_done.item: Full custom internal selection buffer across viewports
deliberately_not_done.why_not: Extremely complex rewrite that would require tracking custom text selections across multiple lipgloss components.

privacy_and_security: No changes to data handling or permissions.

faq.question: How do I select text in the TUI now?
faq.answer: Press ctrl+y to enable selection mode, select text natively with your mouse, then press ctrl+y again when done.

bottom_line: This maintenance release resolves core UI glitches and unlocks standard mouse text selection via ctrl+y toggle.

claim_sources.claim: Text selection fixed via ctrl+y keybinding
